parsed.notes: The leverage ratio is a debt-to-capitalization percentage as defined in the credit agreement, not a debt/EBITDA multiple. Values are in percent: actual 17.1%, maximum 60%. Tangible net worth and investments amounts are in thousands of dollars. The stated base tangible net worth requirement is $3.5 billion; the table shows the adjusted requirement of $3,610,498 thousand. The debt-to-capital figures (26.9% and 26.0%) and net debt-to-capital figures (18.9% and 16.9%) are non-GAAP performance measures and are excluded. Ratios that only set pricing-grid margins or fees are also excluded.
